dedupe_keys.name: eeco electricity emissions and cost model

description: WE3Lab publishes EECO, a Python package for calculating electricity-related emissions and costs within optimisation and other computational studies. Its README names the Electric Emissions and Cost Optimizer, links documentation and a software DOI, and gives installation and test commands. Users provide electricity quantities, factors or tariff assumptions through the package interface; outputs are cost and emissions terms suitable for a larger model objective. Geographic coverage follows the grid factors and prices chosen by the analyst. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that EECO is a component, not a complete electricity dispatch or power-flow simulator; outcomes depend on external activity data and the chosen emissions accounting boundary. It can help compare the operating cost and carbon consequences of infrastructure energy choices. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model is a system optimiser that could use such parameters conceptually, without verified integration. No input datasets or package were downloaded.
inputs: Electricity use, tariffs and emissions factors
